title: Invite outcome messages: the no-mail hand-over matches the verified-address rule (follow-up to #34883)
body:
security#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

Follow-up owed by #34883, from contract review S2. Text only.

**Rule after #34883:** accepting, declining and listing invitations require a verified address. A deployment without live mail therefore cannot complete invitation onboarding for an invitee whose account no provider has verified. The platform admin creates the account instead (see `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`).

**Out of date:**
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/invite-outcome-messages.ts` (around :24 and :32) still answers every invite and resend on a no-mail deployment with "Use Copy Invite Link on the invitation to share it."
- Its generated translations carry the same text.

**Done when:**
- The no-mail invite and resend outcomes state the rule above and point at the operator path, matching the docs.
- The translations are regenerated.
- No behaviour changes.

Land after #34883.
